name: player_transition_to_master_type_sub

functional_evidence: Binary Ninja review shows ECX saveState and EDX flags; the function sets damageVisualFlag and applies gun-slot offsets before the cooldown and unlock gates.

The implementation selects the SUB modal state, validates the active alt weapon against the new modal state, updates the one-second transition cooldown, stops stale TRACK/AMPHIB light handles, and starts the SUB transition light handle through the reviewed zEffect callees.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the coherent player master-type transition/class pass; isolated byte identity may be affected by class context, inlining, and neighboring function layout.
